text:
emma.finance: FYI received invoice QRL-4823 from QuantumRails. It lists PO `45021` (Infra EU) but line items are charged to GL `SW-ENG`. Also shows a 5% early-pay discount that isn't on PO 45021. attaching pdf.
ap-bot: PO lookup -> `45021` = Infra EU (approver=nina.approvals, cost center=CCTR-330). Detected PO/GL mismatch. Recommended: vendor confirm PO or issue credit/reissue invoice.
rafael.procure: @vendor-quantumrails can you confirm which PO you meant to use? looks like `45022` is the SW Eng PO.
vendor-quantumrails: Apologies 12 our AR pulled the wrong PO and applied our master-svc early-pay automatically. The correct target is PO `45022` (SW Eng). We can either reissue the invoice with 45022 and remove the 5% or issue a credit referencing QRL-4823 and then send a corrected invoice.
nina.approvals: Vendor-side reissue preferred. If they only do a credit note, make sure it references the original invoice. If they ask us to accept the discount, need contract clause + legal ok. @cj.finance_ops any block?
cj.finance_ops: Prefer vendor fix too. If we accept discount internally, will need GL reclass to SW-ENG (CCTR-210) and signed amendment. Also audit prefers vendor-side credit/reissue.
rafael.procure: Good. Vendor, please send credit note referencing QRL-4823 and then reissue invoice with PO `45022` and no discount. I'll pause the approver routing until docs arrive.
vendor-quantumrails: Understood. We'll generate credit note today referencing QRL-4823 and reissue corrected invoice with PO 45022. Sorry for the mix-up.
emma.finance: I'll put the invoice on hold in AP (status: on_hold) and open a ticket so it won't auto-pay. Ticket AP-10042 created. I'll exclude from this month's accruals.
ap-bot: Ticket created: AP-10042 | reason: PO/GL mismatch + vendor early-pay applied | owner=emma.finance | status=on_hold
nina.approvals: Ping me once credit note + reissue land and I'll re-run the routing. If vendor pushes for exception instead, we need legal sign-off.
emma.finance: Noted and logged for audit: reason=wrong PO + unauthorized discount; action=await credit note or corrected invoice; ticket=AP-10042. Will update thread on receipt.
